purpose: Define structured context for translation quality, including UI surface, semantic owner, grammatical role and usage hints, so translators do not infer meaning from isolated strings.

topics.name: Label Context Metadata
topics.purpose: Define structured context for translation quality, including UI surface, semantic owner, grammatical role and usage hints, so translators do not infer meaning from isolated strings.

semantics.owner_rule: Context links back to the canonical semantic owner being presented.
semantics.grammar_rule: Language-specific grammatical hints may be stored as localization metadata without changing source semantics.
semantics.example_rule: Examples clarify usage but are non-authoritative prose.
semantics.trace_rule: A translated label can trace to source label identity and semantic owner.

invariants.rule: Localization changes human-facing labels and explanatory text only; canonical identities, commands and machine semantics remain language-independent.

hard_gates.condition: translation context exists only in translator prose outside canonical data
semantic owner ref missing where needed
translated label cannot trace to source identity
